LCOM-CONC.description: Load Combination Auto Generation - Concrete (LCOM-CONC). Auto-generates concrete design load combinations for design code KDS 41 20 : 2022; OPTION and DGNCODE drive the run while the remaining optional blocks (response-spectrum scale-up, wind, orthogonal effect, additional seismic loads, underground loads, construction-stage / prestress-loss flags) act as auto-generation knobs, each absent block behaving as unchecked / disabled.

Argument.description: Request body (auto-generation knobs). Only OPTION and DGNCODE are required; the minimal body is {"OPTION":"...","DGNCODE":"KDS 41 20 : 2022"}. Absent optional fields behave as unchecked/disabled.

OPTION.description: Add or Replace existing combinations (case-insensitive). ADD appends to existing combinations; REPLACE wipes this design type's combinations then regenerates.

DGNCODE.description: Design Code (case-insensitive). Only "KDS 41 20 : 2022" is admitted for concrete; any other string is rejected at deserialization.

RS_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Response Spectrum Scale Factor. Optional; absent means no scale-up rows. Each row references a spectrum (response-spectrum) load case; FACTOR must be in [0, 10].

LOAD_CASE.description: Response Spectrum Load Case name (must resolve to an existing spectrum load case).

WIND_LOAD_COMB.description: Wind Load Combination Set. Optional 3-state contract: absent or empty PARAMETERS -> no-op (existing wind combination record untouched); populated -> rebuilt.

PARAMETERS.description: List of wind load combination sets.

BUILDING_TYPE.description: Wind Loads Group (case-insensitive). MIDDLE -> ALONG required, TORSION not used; HIGH -> high-rise dynamic wind, GUST_FACTOR and KAPPA_FACTOR required.

WIND_LOAD_CASE.description: Wind Load Cases. ALONG is required in practice; ACROSS/TORSION are optional and only accept WA/WT load cases produced when the linked static wind load has Across/Torsional wind enabled.

GUST_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] GD gust factor; required for high-rise dynamic wind, unused for MIDDLE.

KAPPA_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE=HIGH] Kappa factor; required for high-rise dynamic wind, unused for MIDDLE.

ORTHO_EFFECT.description: Orthogonal Effect. When OPT_USE=true, TYPE and LOAD_GROUP are required; LOAD_GROUP must contain exactly 2 distinct load cases of the same load-case type. When OPT_USE=false (or the block is omitted), the orthogonal-effect record is cleared.

TYPE.description: [OPT_USE=true] Orthogonal Effect Type (case-insensitive): 100_30 or SRSS. Required when OPT_USE=true.

LOAD_GROUP.description: [OPT_USE=true] Load Case1, Load Case2 - exactly 2 distinct load cases of the same load-case type (no ST/RS mixing). Required when OPT_USE=true.

ADDITIONAL_LOAD.description: Additional Load. Either half omitted == that half's OPT_USE=false. When both halves are disabled, any prior additional-load record is cleared.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Special Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR, SDS, OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Load Factor; must be > 0 (CheckSlcf strict). Required when OPT_USE=true.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors. Required when OPT_USE=true. Each row's FACTOR must be > 0 and LOAD_CASE must resolve.

VERTICAL_LOAD.description: Vertical Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, FORCE_FACTOR is required.

FORCE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Force Factor; must be > 0 (CheckSlcf strict). Required when OPT_USE=true.

UNDERGROUND_LOAD.description: Underground Load. Optional; absent is treated as unchecked / OPT_USE=false. When OPT_USE=true, SCALE_FACTOR and LOAD_CASE_LIST are required. When OPT_USE=false, underground state is cleared.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground scale factors. Required when OPT_USE=true. FACTOR must be in [0, 10]; LOAD_CASE must resolve to a valid underground load case.

LOAD_CASE_LIST.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground load case list. Required when OPT_USE=true and must contain at least one entry. Each (LoadCase, Direction) pair must be unique.

LOAD_CASE_SEISMIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Seismic. Each entry must be a static load case of type EEP.

LOAD_CASE_STATIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Static. Each entry must be a static load case of type EH.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Underground special load. Optional even when OPT_USE=true. When its own OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR, SDS, OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to use special load for underground load.

VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Vertical Load Factor; must be > 0. Required when OPT_USE=true.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors for underground special load. Required when OPT_USE=true. Each row's FACTOR must be > 0 and (LoadCase, Type) must be unique.
